'''Jeff Hansen''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Rogue 5 from Billings, Mt.<ref name="pc-reprint">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/decipher-swccg-squadron-members/ Decipher SWCCG Squadron Members], starwarsccg.org (Players Committee, 1 July 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020195703/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/decipher-swccg-squadron-members.html Internet Archive].</ref> The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

[[Travis Rumans]]'s DeckTech report of the [[August 2001 Billings tournament (25 August)|25 August 2001 Billings tournament]] names the tournament director only as "Jeff", who played to bring the field to eight. Hansen finished 4th at the event.<ref name="tr-d2903" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== Writing ==

The original GeoCities Corellian Engineering home page billed Hansen as "Rogue 5" for a "Neglected Cards" series of about 40 card reviews. He also wrote the follow-up "CounterStrategies: Protection from Misdirection."<ref name="geo2001">[http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/ Corellian Engineering Corporation home page], GeoCities (13 May 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010513005725/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/ Internet Archive]</ref>
